Definition: prolongation from the base of G3993; necessitous:--poor.
BiblicalUsage: Penichros means poor, necessitous. Jesus watched a certain poor widow cast two mites into the treasury — the smallest gift in the room, and the greatest in His eyes.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God measures the gift by what it cost, not by what it weighed: two mites from a poor widow outweigh a fortune from the rich.
